title: APIs con FastAPI y contratos HTTP
scope: FULL_SECTION_EXTENSION: existing theory/reference audit + I Do + 24 We Do + You Do + rubric + self-check + resources + canonical CP-N4-A alignment
executive_verdict: S41 no está lista para enseñar ni evaluar una API FastAPI gobernada. La teoría ya tenía 40 defectos materiales; la apertura de práctica/evaluación añade 18. Dos son P0: (1) el proyecto independiente puede cerrar sin usar FastAPI, Pydantic, Depends, TestClient u OpenAPI; (2) puede declarar READY con idempotencia secuencial en memoria aunque la propia teoría dice explícitamente que esa prueba no cubre concurrencia ni reinicio. La secuencia práctica vuelve a sustituir garantías por nombres/flags: metadata incompleta ordena replay, validación significa presencia de keys, CPU y durabilidad vuelven a colapsarse como background, timeout/cierre/test coverage/compatibilidad/privacy se reciben como booleans y no como resultados ejecutados. El alumno puede salir con vocabulario correcto y una falsa sensación de haber probado el sistema.

live_status.public_card_tagline: API versionada que crea jobs y consulta resultados/evidencia, sin exponer PII ni claves internas
live_status.body_hydration: Public crawl exposes overview/card but not a trustworthy fresh hydrated S41 body; no render-only defects invented.
live_status.reason: The crawl is from last month and still reports the old 1040h course total; freshness is insufficient for a deployment defect.

capstone_alignment.misalignment: S41 callouts, exercise feedback and You Do repeatedly call local evidence/gate CP-N4-A as though it closes at S41.

external_comparison.FastAPI_testing: Official FastAPI docs make TestClient + pytest a direct, local way to test an app; leaving it optional in a section named FastAPI is an assessment-design failure.
external_comparison.FastAPI_response_model: Official response models validate/document/filter output and feed OpenAPI; S41 substitutes hand-written allow-list dictionaries and `openapi_matches` booleans.
external_comparison.HTTP_RFC9110: 405 is for a known target resource with unsupported method and requires Allow; 201 Location identifies the created resource when supplied.
external_comparison.Idempotency_Key_status: The latest IETF Idempotency-Key document is an expired Internet-Draft as of 2026-04-18; it is not a finalized RFC. It emphasizes key uniqueness/non-reuse with different payload.
external_comparison.FastAPI_background: Official FastAPI docs distinguish small same-process BackgroundTasks from heavy computation that may need separate worker/process tooling; durability is a separate guarantee.

highest_risk_findings.why: The learner can pass a FastAPI section without using FastAPI.
The learner can pass idempotency with a sequential in-memory dict despite explicit theory warning that this is insufficient.
Missing version metadata is routed to replay rather than inspection, teaching an unsafe fail-closed rule.
Final readiness never checks the core 201 create contract.
The visible rubric scores future/unimplemented controls and blurs local S41 evidence with CP-N4-A.

cross_element_issues.problem: FastAPI remains a named concept/resource link, not a mandatory executable skill.
The lesson correctly says sequential dict is insufficient, then uses it as final acceptance evidence.
Pydantic types/ranges are promised; presence-only validation is taught and graded.
The correct distinction CPU isolation vs durability is lost in both practice and retrieval assessment.
Incremental API evidence is repeatedly described as the capstone gate even though the canonical gate is S43.
Old-consumer compatibility is never executed in You Do.
Privacy/trace claims are checked by one key or boolean rather than across response/error/log/trace surfaces.

rejected_findings.claim: The legacy id `llm-finetuning` must be renamed now.
rejected_findings.reason: It is a stable progress/URL key. Fix mappings or perform explicit migration rather than destroying saved progress.

rejected_findings.claim: FastAPI returning 422 for invalid request bodies is itself wrong.
rejected_findings.reason: FastAPI uses request validation errors/422; S41's defect is that its own exercises do not use the framework/schema promised.
They are valid for small same-process post-response work; they just do not imply CPU isolation or durability.
The important correction is to teach Location semantics/recommendation when the created resource has a URI, not invent a universal MUST.
Keyset is appropriate; S41 fails to define unique/stable ordering and invalid-cursor behavior.

rejected_findings.claim: `trace_id` is forbidden in RFC 9457 Problem Details.
rejected_findings.reason: RFC 9457 permits extension members; it should be labeled an extension, not a standard member.

priority_order: P0: Make FastAPI/Pydantic/TestClient/OpenAPI mandatory in You Do (S41-F41).
P0: Replace sequential in-memory idempotency acceptance with durable atomic scope/fingerprint + concurrency/reopen tests (S41-F42).
P1: Restore actual HTTP acceptance: 201/Location, 404/405+Allow, schema validation and no side effect on 422 (F43-F44).
P1: Add frozen v1 consumer and align local S41 rubric to canonical S43 CP-N4-A role (F45,F48).
P1: Repair replay-on-missing-version and reference-solution contradiction (F49-F50).
P1: Rebuild T3/T4 practice from flags to executed CPU/durable/timeout/test/rate/privacy evidence (F52-F55).
P1: Add explicit uncertainty path and either test or remove timeout/rate/trace claims from You Do (F46-F47).
P2: Diversify We Do and repair Q7/Q8 recovery semantics (F56-F58).
Then repair inherited theory findings F01-F40 without weakening their accurate paragraphs.

USABLE: HTTP status is part of the API contract; collection empty differs from item missing.
The T3-A theory distinction between async I/O, CPU isolation and durable work is conceptually strong.
FastAPI TestClient can test local apps directly with pytest; a cloud deployment is not required.
Response models can validate/document/filter output and contribute to generated OpenAPI.
Idempotency semantics require distinguishing created/replay/conflict and preserving operation identity.
CP-N4-A closes at S43; S41 contributes the API increment.
MISCONCEPTION_RISK: A FastAPI section can be mastered without running FastAPI.
Sequential dict replay proves production idempotency.
Missing version metadata should trigger replay.
Schema validation means required keys exist.
CPU-heavy and durable are the same background boundary.
seeded_failure_detected=True proves a test caught the bug.
used/limit without time is rate limiting.
retry_after_s is the standard HTTP retry signal.
